item.title: Pertussis prevention through maternal vaccination - more can be done
item.description: Agreement I do not AgreeBody This is a useful paper on severe pertussis in the UK which is helpful for general paediatricians and intensivists alike. It highlights the ongoing and significant burden of pertussis in the UK as well as providing insights into the practical management and prognostication of severe pertussis cases. item.title: Reference ranges for vitamin B12 in children are higher than for adults
item.description: Agreement I do not AgreeBody Dear Editor, Ismail et al. report a common concern, regarding high vitamin B12 levels in children. It is unfortunate that they use an upper limit of the reference range of 771 ng/L which is suitable for adults of White and Asian backgrounds, but not for adults of Black backgrounds, nor for children.
